verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents one questionnaire flow: the tax-registration questionnaire is filled in digitally and turned into an ELSTER XML document sent to the tax office. Incorporation requests also take structured company, shareholder and director details. Nothing shows a broader guided-questionnaire template library, validation that documents are filled in correctly, or flagging of choices for attorney or notary review. Missing for 10: guided interview-style questionnaires across legal document types, correctness validation, flagging of choices that need attorney review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer guided questionnaires that fill in legal documents correctly and flag choices that need attorney review

citations.quote: Der Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung wird vollständig digital ausgefüllt und über die offizielle ELSTER-Schnittstelle an das Finanzamt übermittelt.
Submit a company's details to start its tax registration. An ELSTER XML document will be generated and sent the tax office, which reviews and files the registration.
This endpoint creates an incorporation request for a company in Germany such as a GmbH or UG, including company details, shareholders, and directors.
